name: org_graph_as_of
description: Read the Org Graph as it stood on one date: the live units with their parent, level, owners and direct member count, the top structure's unit types with the type ids each could sit under (parent_ids) and whether it could sit at the top, the same for each unit that had a structure of its own (structures, by unit_id), and the number of employed people. A future date includes changes already recorded for it, such as a hire who starts then or a scheduled move. known_on reads what the Org Graph knew at the end of that earlier date in the tenant's time zone, leaving out corrections learned since. mode "full" adds each employed person's facts (title, level, manager, site, employment) and every membership. unit_id narrows to that unit and the units under it, counting only the people placed there. People are named by id only.

known_on.description: Date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for what is known now.
